sections.title: N+1 query patterns
sections.content:
**`control/ai_mesh_control/mcp_connector/views.py:1640,1864`** — `MCPScanControl.objects.filter(organization=org)` runs twice per tool call (input scan + output scan), on the hottest control-plane path. A `mcp:scan_ver:{org_slug}` cache-invalidation counter already exists in `signals.py::bump_scan_version` but isn't used here.
```python

sections.title: after: fetch once, reuse; or cache keyed on scan_ver
sections.content:
controls = list(MCPScanControl.objects.filter(organization=org))
```

**`control/ai_mesh_control/auth/views.py:676-698` + `auth/serializers.py:197-234`** — `UserManagementListCreateView`'s `platform_role` field touches `user.profile` + `.roles` M2M per row with no `select_related`/`prefetch_related`, and the view isn't paginated. A 300-user org triggers ~600 extra queries on one page load.
```python

sections.title: fix
sections.content:
User.objects.select_related("profile").prefetch_related("roles")
```

**`gateway/ai_mesh_gateway/mcp_proxy.py:2814+2842, 3082+3130, 4084+4134`** — `_get_server_config` and `_get_enabled_tools` each independently re-fetch the same 2-key Redis version pair via `_current_scan_version`, duplicating a round trip per tool call at 3 call sites. Resolve the version once per request and pass it down.

sections.title: Unnecessary React re-renders
sections.content:
**`frontend/src/context/AuthContext.jsx:293`, `context/ThemeContext.jsx:77`** — highest-impact single fix in the frontend. Provider value is a fresh object literal every render, so any state change (e.g. a `loading` flip) re-renders every consumer app-wide, since `useAuth()` is used almost everywhere:
```jsx
// before
return <AuthContext.Provider value={{ user, loading, login, logout }}>

// after — matches the correct pattern already used in hooks/useFirewallConfig.jsx:89
const value = useMemo(() => ({ user, loading, login, logout }), [user, loading]);
return <AuthContext.Provider value={value}>
```

**`components/OutputGovernancePanel.jsx`** — `EventRow` (line 51) isn't memoized and gets an inline `onToggle` closure per row (line 259), which defeats memoization even if added; 5 unmemoized `.filter()` passes run over up to 500 events on every render (lines 168-184), compounded by a 10s auto-poll.

**`components/MCPConnectorPanel.jsx`** — 2630 lines (5x this repo's 500-line limit), `renderServerCard` is a plain function rather than an extracted component, so React can't skip reconciliation. Typing in the "Add Server" modal re-renders every server card because modal state shares render scope with the list. Extracting `ServerCard` as `React.memo`'d component is the fix.

Codebase-wide: 0/120 `.jsx` files use `React.memo`, only 16/120 use `useMemo`, 36/120 `useCallback`.

sections.title: Caching opportunities
sections.content:
**`policy/evaluation_views.py:494`** (`PolicyCheckView.post`) — fetches `Policy.objects.filter(...).prefetch_related("rules")` fresh on every prompt/response turn even though policies only change on admin edit. Redis `CACHES["default"]` is configured and idle here — cache keyed on a policy-version counter (same pattern as `bump_scan_version`).

**`gateway/ai_mesh_gateway/config_sync.py:546-594`** (`_reload_llm_models`) and **`policy_sync.py:285-305`** (`_load_initial_bundle`) — both do sequential per-key Redis `GET` in a loop after a `scan_iter`; should batch with `mget`.

sections.title: Memory leaks
sections.content:
**`gateway/ai_mesh_gateway/mcp_sandbox_client.py:175,214,294`** (`broker_send_jsonrpc`/`broker_send_rpc`) — fresh `httpx.AsyncClient()` created per MCP tool call, the hottest path in the whole MCP chain (verified still present just now). Fix mirrors the already-proven pattern in this same file's sibling `jobs.py`:
```python

sections.title: jobs.py already does this correctly — copy the pattern here
sections.content:
_CLIENT: httpx.AsyncClient | None = None
def _get_client() -> httpx.AsyncClient:
    global _CLIENT
    if _CLIENT is None:
        _CLIENT = httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=_http_timeout(timeout))
    return _CLIENT
```
13 more unpooled sites exist in `mcp_proxy.py` (lines 602–5355, confirmed above) — `mcp_proxy.py:141-150`'s `_control_audit_client` already proves the pooled pattern works (documented ~47 RPS throughput fix); it just wasn't propagated.

**`gateway/ai_mesh_gateway/mcp_oauth.py:65`** `_registered_clients` — written on every `/oauth/register`, never read, never evicted (unlike sibling `_auth_codes`, which has `_cleanup_expired()`). This is unbounded-growth **and** an unauthenticated DoS vector, not just perf.

**`middleware.py`** `_last_used_stamp` and **`mcp_oauth_proxy.py`** `_oauth_tokens` — both unbounded in-memory dicts with no TTL sweep (sibling `_oauth_flows` in the same file does have one).

**Frontend**: zero `AbortController` usage across the entire `src/` tree; only 2/120 files guard `setState`-after-unmount. Every other `useEffect`+fetch (51 files) leaks on fast unmount/route-change.

sections.title: Redundant computations
sections.content:
**`gateway/ai_mesh_gateway/rag_pipeline/retriever_stage.py:212-213`** — confirmed just now: `doc.get("id", hashlib.sha256(content.encode()).hexdigest()[:16])` evaluates the SHA-256 eagerly (Python evaluates default args regardless of whether the key exists), then line 213 hashes the same content again unconditionally. Two SHA-256 passes per doc per RAG query, one always wasted:
```python
content_hash = hashlib.sha256(content.encode()).hexdigest()
doc_id = doc.get("id", content_hash[:16])
```

**`gateway/ai_mesh_gateway/vector_routes.py:409`** — blocking `REDIS_CLIENT.keys(f"vector:provider:{org_id}:*")` at 4 call sites (409, 588, 1005, 1222/1324), O(total keys in DB) instead of O(matches). Replace with `SCAN` or an indexed `SET`.

**`ranker_stage.py:220-235`** — per-doc `scan_single_document()` awaited sequentially instead of `asyncio.gather`; `grounding_guard.py` in the same pipeline already does this correctly for embeddings — inconsistent pattern within one pipeline.

**`mcp_scan_orchestrator.py:979-1010`** — Tier-2 loop does sequential Bedrock round-trips per extracted text field instead of `asyncio.gather`.

---

**Highest-priority first fixes** (by impact/effort): AuthContext/ThemeContext `useMemo` (2-line, app-wide render fix) → `mcp_sandbox_client.py` pooled client (hottest MCP path, proven pattern already exists in `jobs.py`) → `retriever_stage.py` double-hash (1-line reorder) → `mcp_oauth.py _registered_clients` (security exposure, not just perf).

None of this has been fixed yet — say the word if you want me to implement any of these (I'd start with the AuthContext memoization and the sandbox client pooling, since both are small, isolated, high-impact changes).
